title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:
Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.
Responsabilidades:
Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio
Exigências do Cargo:
Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;
Escolaridade mínima:
Ensino médio técnico completo
Qualificação A: antes do embarque:
Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
Well Control IWCF – Level 3
Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

title: Engenheiro Eletricista
description:
Engenheiro Eletricista | Sistemas Embarcados e Plataformas Marítimas
Sobre a Tidewise
A Tidewise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.
Descrição da Vaga
A Tidewise está em busca de um(a)
Engenheiro Elétricista
com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas elétricos embarcados, domínio de ferramentas CAD para projeto elétrico (especialmente
SolidWorks Electrical
) e conhecimento em documentação técnica para fabricação e montagem.
Essa pessoa atuará diretamente com as equipes de engenharia, produção e integração de sistemas, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento detalhado, montagem e validação de sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos em plataformas robóticas marítimas inovadoras.
Trata-se de uma posição prática, com impacto direto nos produtos da empresa, que exige organização, atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de lidar com diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida de um projeto e boa comunicação entre áreas.
Responsabilidades
Desenvolver projetos elétricos
a partir de conceitos e requisitos de sistema
, incluindo a definição da arquitetura elétrica, estratégias de controle e interfaces entre subsistemas.
Realizar
estudos de balanço de carga
, dimensionamento de circuitos, proteções, fontes de energia e consumo elétrico dos sistemas embarcados.
Desenvolver esquemáticos elétricos, diagramas de conexão e layout de painéis no
SolidWorks Electrical,
em colaboração com os engenheiros eletricistas.
Criar modelos e desenhos 3D de montagem elétrica utilizando o
SolidWorks Mecânico (3D)
, em colaboração com os engenheiros eletricistas e mecanicos.
Realizar
projeto e roteamento de placas de circuito impresso (PCBs)
Elaborar documentação técnica de montagem e checklists de instalação elétrica.
Desenvolver planos e procedimentos de teste para sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos.
Troubleshooting
de sistemas, tanto em bancada quanto a bordo.
Preparar e organizar bancadas de teste e validação.
Atualizar a documentação técnica "
as built
" conforme modificações ocorridas durante montagem e testes.
Realizar o controle técnico de montagem e supervisar a instalação elétrica.
Criação, atualização e manutenção de listas de materiais no sistem
ERP
(BOMs);
Pesquisa de fornecedores e solicitação de orçamentos;
Requisitos
Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência comprovada com software CAD para projetos elétricos
(ex: SolidWorks Electrical, EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical).
Experiência com roteamento de PCBs e uso de ferramentas como
Altium Designer
,
Eagle
ou
KiCAD
.
Capacidade de desenvolver documentação técnica clara e organizada para montagem e operação.
Inglês técnico escrito
, com capacidade de leitura e elaboração de documentação técnica.
Experiência em ambiente de produção, montagem ou campo, com foco em integração de sistemas elétricos.
Organização e atenção a detalhes, com compromisso com a qualidade da documentação.
Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
Diferenciais Desejáveis
Experiência com
SolidWorks Electrical
e
SolidWorks Mecânico 3D
.
Familiaridade com sistemas de automação, incluindo
CLPs e microcontroladores
.
Familiaridade com
normas ABNT
, especialmente
NBR 5410
(instalações elétricas de baixa tensão).
Certificação ou conhecimento prático da
NR10
– Segurança em Instalações e Serviços em Eletricidade.
Vivência em sistemas embarcados, marítimos ou robóticos.
Experiência com ERP e processos de compras técnicas.
O Que Oferecemos
Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos inovadores e de alto impacto na indústria marítima e robótica.
Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, dinâmico e em constante evolução tecnológica.
Contato direto com todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de produto, da concepção à operação.
Salário e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.
Participação em uma empresa que está moldando o futuro da tecnologia naval e robótica marítima.
Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo!

title: Analista Financeiro/Backoffice
description:
Descrição da Empresa
O Axxon Group é uma das gestoras pioneiras no mercado brasileiro de private equity, investindo desde 2001 em empresas de médio porte. A empresa atua em diversos setores e possui vasta experiência no desenvolvimento e na profissionalização de empresas familiares no Brasil. Os sócios da Axxon têm uma longa trajetória de investimentos na região, com uma abordagem ativa na gestão das empresas do portfólio. Desde sua fundação, o Axxon já investiu mais de US$ 700 milhões em vinte e quatro empresas plataforma.
Descrição do Cargo
Buscamos um Analista Financeiro/Backoffice para integrar nossa equipe no escritório de Rio de Janeiro, RJ. As responsabilidades incluem gestão operacional de entradas, saídas e amortizações; contas a pagar das gestoras e acompanhamento de budget; execução e controle de câmbio; suporte à área de Relações com Investidores, incluindo atendimento a solicitações e revisão de relatórios trimestrais; interface com auditoria interna e externa; e apoio ao desenvolvimento da equipe, garantindo qualidade nas rotinas diárias.
Qualificações
***** Necessário inglês fluente *****
Relatórios e Demonstrações Financeiras:
Experiência na elaboração, análise e revisão de relatórios financeiros e demonstrações contábeis, garantindo precisão e conformidade.
Conhecimentos em Finanças:
Sólido domínio de conceitos financeiros e capacidade para gerir operações financeiras com eficiência e atenção a detalhes.
Experiência em Auditoria:
Vivência prévia em firmas de auditoria é altamente desejável, pela base técnica e rigor nos processos.
Organização e Agilidade:
Habilidade para lidar com múltiplos processos simultâneos, prazos de fechamento e demandas complexas.
Maturidade Profissional:
Perfil Pleno ou Sênior, com autonomia para executar rotinas operacionais, propor melhorias e atuar de forma resiliente e estratégica.
Formação Acadêmica:
Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas, Inglês fluente é necessário.
Diferenciais:
Experiência no setor de Private Equity ou em funções similares será considerada um plus.

title: Product Owner - Consultor(a) Senior
description:
Descrição do perfil
Responsável por liderar a condução de projetos e iniciativas ágeis de ponta a ponta, desde a definição das histórias e priorização do backlog até o acompanhamento da entrega final, assegurando a qualidade e integridade conceitual das entregas. Atua garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio e técnica para assegurar que as entregas estejam alinhadas ao escopo definido e aos objetivos da empresa. Além disso, mantém as práticas Scrum, apoia os outros papéis e garante comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads, atuando como educador para assegurar o respeito aos valores e metodologia ágil.
Principais atividades
Apoiar a gestão de projetos de lançamento de novas ofertas considerando atividades E2E, desde a solicitação do gerente de produto até o delivery técnico;
Definir a visão do produto, seu roadmap e oportunidades de crescimento com os diversos stakeholders;
Construir escopo junto com Líder de Produto, atuando no processo de elaboração de user stories garantindo requisitos necessários e alinhamento de expectativas junto às áreas de negócio;
Liderar grupos multidisciplinares para garantir a correta especificação do produto, ajudando na análise e negociação de impactos diretamente com as áreas de negócio;
Desafiar as áreas de negócio acerca de features de produtos, processos ou regras;
Traduzir a estratégia de negócios para o time técnico, garantindo o entendimento dos requisitos;
Negociar escopos prioritários com foco na estratégia de negócios, discutindo trade-offs estratégicos;
Validar refinamentos técnicos garantindo aderência ao escopo solicitado;
Conduzir cerimônias ágeis de alta transversalidade (diversas esteiras/sprints de desenvolvimento), centralizando decisões estratégicas;
Elaborar critérios de aceite para garantir alinhamento com demais times envolvidos, assegurando visão única de projeto/produto;
Realizar a validação e aprovação dos testes garantindo a qualidade da entrega e coordenar aprovação dos demais times envolvidos;
Acompanhar entrega e performance dos testes pós-produção para garantir funcionamento e velocidade na correção;
Apontar issues para serem endereçados pelo time técnico identificado;
Controlar cronograma e budget dos projetos garantindo aderência à estratégia;
Manter um olhar atento, crítico e propositivo durante todas as etapas do projeto, utilizando dados, aprendizados e feedbacks para monitorar a aderência ao processo e propor melhorias contínuas de forma assertiva;
Garantir a manutenção das práticas Scrum, apoiar os papéis envolvidos e manter a comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads;
Atuar como educador para assegurar que todos os participantes conheçam e respeitem os princípios e valores do Scrum.
Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Experiência como Product Owner, Project Manager ou Scrum Master com atuação prática em projetos ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de backlog, elaboração de histórias e releases;
  • Capacidade de atuar com diferentes stakeholders e áreas técnicas, negociando escopos e prazos;
  • Habilidade para escrever e organizar user stories, critérios de aceite e planos de entrega;
  • Conhecimento em rituais ágeis e na condução de cerimônias com múltiplas esteiras ou times;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e com forte senso de responsabilidade pela entrega de valor;
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Azure, Jira, Monday;
  • Boa capacidade de articulação, visão crítica e habilidade de propor melhorias processuais com base em experiência prática;
  • Inglês avançado é obrigatório;
  • Graduação Completa em Administração/Marketing/Tecnologia/Engenharia.
    Na TIM, o seu bem-estar é o nosso bem-estar, por isso o programa Conexão Bem + Estar tem o propósito de fortalecer o cuidado genuíno da TIM com o TIMe e suas famílias, por meio de iniciativas práticas em diversas frentes para todos e todas estarem sempre bem, na vida pessoal e profissional.

  • Aparelho celular com Internet Ilimitada e franquia de Voz
  • Curso de inglês online extensível a 1 familiar ou amigo
  • Programa de Treinamento e Capacitação Internos
  • Participação nos Lucros
  • Meu primeiro benefício - Auxílio para filhos até 2 anos de idade
  • Reembolso Creche (para pais ou mães)

title: Lower School Librarian
description:

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.
Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.
Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.
Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):
Operational Leadership
Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.
Team Development
Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.
Compliance & QHSE
Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.
Commercial
Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.
Team Culture and Engagement
Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.
Client Account Management
Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.
Coordination Responsibilities
Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.
Qualifications and Skills
Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.
Personal Attributes
Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.
Additional Information:
This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.
Travel
Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.
HSE Awareness:
All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.
Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.
We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.
Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.
Apply now
and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office;
    CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:


Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais;
liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
  • Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
  • Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
  • Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations

description:
1. About Us

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan , one of the world’s leading delivery platforms. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people access food and daily essentials globally. This is more than just a job—it’s a chance to unlock your potential, expand your international outlook, and contribute meaningfully to innovation on a global scale.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Elaborar documentação técnica de montagem e checklists de instalação elétrica.

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas.

  • Inglês técnico escrito , com capacidade de leitura e elaboração de documentação técnica.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties:

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.


Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.Js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.


Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.G., Kafka), and feature flag management.


Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation .

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

  • Suporte à Produção Sênior (N2/N3) em sistemas críticos, com atuação em ambientes financeiros, RTB (Real Time Banking) e SCB, realizando análise e resolução de incidentes de alta complexidade.

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Coordenador Comercial B2c - Rio De Janeiro
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Genial Investimentos é uma das maiores plataformas de investimentos do Brasil. Com mais de 2 milhões de clientes, estamos presentes em todo o país por meio de nossos escritórios e assessores parceiros.


Nascemos com um propósito claro: democratizar o acesso ao mercado financeiro , oferecendo produtos, serviços e tecnologia de ponta para todos os perfis de investidor — do iniciante ao profissional.


Oferecemos um portfólio completo que vai de renda fixa, ações, fundos de investimento, previdência e fundos imobiliários , até soluções de serviços bancários digitais , como conta com Pix, cartão de crédito e pagamentos integrados. Também desenvolvemos soluções sob medida para empresas, como Genial As a Service , que oferece infraestrutura bancária via API.


Mais do que uma plataforma, somos parceiros na construção de um futuro financeiro mais próspero, transparente e acessível.


Quer conhecer mais sobre a Genial? Acesse:

#VemSerGenial


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Executar a estratégia comercial B2C por segmento/produto e funil (habilitação → ativação → captação → recorrência);
  • Liderar, engajar e desenvolver times (feedbacks, 1:1, rituais, playbooks, trilhas técnicas e de vendas);

  • Operar gestão por dados: leitura de dashboards (Power BI/CRM), plano de ação e correções de rota;
  • Gerir relacionamento junto a investidores pessoa física e jurídica, desenvolvendo relacionamento resolutivo, e altamente consultivo, prestando consultoria financeira e comercializando de forma sustentável os produtos de investimento, de forma a gerar e manter alto nível de relacionamento com investidor final;
  • Acompanhar informações sobre todos os produtos de investimentos, como ativos de renda fixa, variável, emissões primárias, performance de fundos de investimentos;
  • Contribuir com modelos de negócio, precificação e esteiras por perfil de cliente;
  • Trabalhar no ramp-up de talentos e alocação eficiente de carteiras.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência na comercialização de produtos financeiros e assessoria direta com cliente final;
  • Necessário ter a certificação CPA-20 ou CEA (Certificação CFP será um diferencial);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro ou possuir disponibilidade para mudanças;
  • Perfil empreendedor.


Informações adicionais


  • Assistência Médica (Amil - coparticipação)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Omint)
  • Seguro de Vida (Mapfre)
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação (Alelo)

  • Conexa Saúde
  • TotalPass e Wellhub
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)


Nosso escritório fica localizado na Praia de Botafogo, Rio de Janeiro.


Etapas do processo

  1. Cadastro
  2. Validação Talent Attraction
  3. Validação Gestor
  4. Validação Area Parceira 1
  5. Proposta
  6. Contratação


Venha ser Genial você também!

O que é ser Genial?

É buscar a excelência, é fazer acontecer. É ser talentoso, inteligente, curioso e aceitar qualquer desafio. É se apresentar e defender as suas ideias. É colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar e ser apaixonado pelo que faz.


Por que a Genial?

Porque somos digitais, mas também somos humanos. Se você, assim como nós, acredita que investimento não é sinônimo de terno e gravata, queremos conhecer você!


Sobre Nós

A empresa que investe em você! Descomplicamos o mercado financeiro para que nossos clientes consigam tomar boas decisões na hora de investir.


Nossos Valores

Buscar os melhores resultados para os clientes;

Colocar excelência em tudo que fazemos;

Ser uma empresa responsável, transparente e sustentável;

Inovar para inspirar;

Ser apaixonado pelo que faz;

Aprender e melhorar sempre.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills;
    fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

title: Senior C/.Net Full-Stack Dba Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases .


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments.


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems.


Key Responsibilities


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures to support high-performance application workloads
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability strategies in Azure SQL
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention
  • Own database cost management in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence throughout the application lifecycle


Software Development & Feature Delivery

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems
  • Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack
  • Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers


Azure Cloud & DevOps

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices using Azure DevOps
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost


Required Qualifications


Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of professional experience in C#/.NET software development
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency)


Technical Skills (Priority Order)

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including:

Advanced T-SQL

Stored procedures and query optimization

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis

Performance tuning and troubleshooting

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including:

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery

Performance monitoring and scaling

Cost and capacity management in Azure

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Bonus Points

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar)
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio
  • Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to own critical systems and influence architectural decisions
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit
